description:
Otnox helps suppliers find and assess public procurement opportunities directly in ChatGPT.

What you can ask:
- Search open tenders by country, category, keyword, deadline and value across 85 national procurement markets in Europe, Latin America, Africa and Asia.
- Open a tender: buyer, deadline, estimated value and a link to the published notice.
- Look up a contracting authority: what it buys, how much, and which suppliers win.
- Check the competition on a tender: number of bidders, single-bidder history, recurring winners.
- Ask whether to bid: a fit assessment against your saved company profile. Each new assessment uses 5 assessment credits from your Otnox account.

On first use the app helps you set up your account: it asks which markets you sell in and what your company does, then saves the markets and the matching procurement categories to your profile.

An Otnox account is required. The markets and features available to you depend on your plan; the app says so when something is outside it.
